npcRoster.name: Jezra Brassbite
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Jezra Brassbite is a Relicborn theorist awakened from an ancient reliquary-core, their “severed head” less a machine part and more a preserved artifact vessel full of fragmented memories, old calculations, and spiteful survival instincts. As a Setrimir-shaped artificial being, they carry the strange inheritance of stolen knowledge, awakened purpose, and relic-born consciousness, making them brilliant, rude, precise, and absolutely convinced that most living people are inefficient arrangements of panic and fluids.
At the Heth'vára Transit Yard, Jezra works with the Regent Lattice as a consultant on rogue constructs, relic systems, divine-residue logic loops, and ichor-corrupted safety protocols. They claim their brutal theories are “mercy by mathematics,” but their fixation on preventing suffering by removing choice, risk, or occasionally the patient makes them useful, terrifying, and best kept far away from unsupervised triage.

Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Dwarf — Mountain Dwarf, Gnome — Rock Gnome, Goliath. Relicborn reads through the Relicborn entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Constructs awakened from ancient artifacts or forgotten relic systems, Relicborn carry fragmented histories within their forms. They are enigmatic and often driven by buried purpose. Table cues: Dance of Death, Eternal Party, Moment of Remembrance, Soul of Revelry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.

sourcePolicy.preserveOriginalProvinceRecords: The 29 overlapping province/distance JSON files were byte-identical between the geography-distance package and the province-area package, so the canonical records are retained and expanded in-place.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.
